result.title: Reward Tilting via Semantic Noising
result.summary: Steering a generative model toward a desired property typically requires separate fine-tuning for each reward or additional computation during sampling. We propose semantic noising, which conditions generation on a noisy semantic representation of the data. The resulting posteriors correspond to exponential tilts by linear-quadratic rewards in semantic space, allowing a single model to support objectives and strengths chosen after training. A conditional generator can be trained to approximate these posteriors directly, while models that generate semantic representations by diffusion provide analytic tilted denoisers for the same family of rewards. We illustrate semantic noising in three settings. An autoregressive molecular generator trained with semantic noising controls properties individually and jointly, with a better reward--KL trade-off than property-conditioned models. On ImageNet, a joint diffusion model of images and their CLIP embeddings achieves FID comparable to REG, and tilting it toward a higher aesthetic score matches the best of 16 samples at the cost of a single sample. Finally, pretrained factorized models such as Kandinsky 2.2 support the same tilts without retraining.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 semantic noising：用带噪语义表示作为条件训练生成器，使后验等价于语义空间中线性二次奖励的指数倾斜，从而用单一模型在训练后选择目标与强度；在分子生成、ImageNet 图文联合扩散及 Kandinsky 2.2 上演示。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作对语义 latent 做指数倾斜以实现事后可控生成，其对内部表示施加奖励导向干预、且无需重训的思路，可能为 latent 推理状态的测试时可控调节提供参考线索，但与原论文的视觉推理问题距离较远，需核查其倾斜对表示内容的影响。
